_설명: 천일문 3권 Chapter 08 접속사에서 가져와 변형한 문항. 은행에서는 심화 9과 접속사 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: not only A but also B 등 상관접속사

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: You will be tired later ______ you rest now.

choices.text: since
unless
so that
when
if

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: ______ I have known Daniel for 8 years, I still don’t know much about him.

choices.text: Because
Before
Unless
When
Although

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: • The painter held her first show ______ she was 25 years old.
• I wonder ______ the winter break starts.

choices.text: while
when
or
because
as

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: • ______ you visit Jeju, you will see many orange trees.
• I’m not sure ______ Mia will come to my concert.

choices.text: Unless[unless]
Though[though]
As[as]
If[if]
Since[since]

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 다른 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> Nara speaks Japanese very well [[since]] she lived in Tokyo.

choices.text: Since I was tired, I went to bed early.
Our trip was canceled since it snowed a lot.
My uncle has worked in Busan since he got a new job.
I took a break since I felt dizzy after running.
They talked quietly since they didn’t want to wake the baby.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 의미가 다른 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> You should lock the door [[as]] you leave the room.

choices.text: I wash my hands first as I get back home.
I saw Mina as I went to the market.
As Wendy turned the corner, a dog ran out from the gate.
As people go in and out, the automatic door opens and closes.
As Tom was sick yesterday, he didn’t come to school.

questions.prompt: 주어진 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: I don’t know. Where does he live now?

questions.prompt: 주어진 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
body: Can you tell me? Will you come to our club meeting?
→ Can you tell me ________________ to our club meeting?

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> I heard [[that]] Minho’s leg was badly hurt.

choices.text: I prefer that jacket over this one.
The movie that you recommended was amazing.
Ms. Park spoke so fast that I couldn’t follow her.
It is strange that he didn’t answer the phone.
Mike left early so that he won’t miss the train.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 <보기>의 밑줄 친 부분과 쓰임이 같은 것을 고르세요.
body: <보기> You can take the last cookie, [[if]] you want it.

choices.text: Blair asked me if I would join the club.
Jim isn’t sure if this can be recycled.
I need to check if my phone is charged.
Mina wonders if the shop opens on Sundays.
My family will go hiking if it is not rainy tomorrow.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 그 상자는 너무 무거워서 그가 혼자 들 수가 없었다.
(the box / heavy / could / not / he / that / was / it / so / lift)
questions.answer: The box was so heavy that he could not lift it

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 극장 안에서는 다른 사람들이 즐길 수 있도록 조용히 해주세요.
(enjoy / so / quiet / others / that / can / be)
→ In the theater, please ________________.
questions.answer: be quiet so that others can enjoy

questions.point_label: not only A but also B
questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 올바르게 배열하세요.
body: 그 공장은 물을 오염시킬 뿐만 아니라 많은 쓰레기도 만든다.
(the water / only / a lot of / makes / pollutes / also / trash / but / not)
questions.answer: not only pollutes the water but also makes a lot of trash

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Tony wonders what is his aunt’s job.
We know why our coach is so angry.
Do you know if can Mia play the violin?
Joey doesn’t know what should he do this weekend.
My sister asked me whether she could borrow my bike.
